statement: Frontier 50%-success task time horizon >= 16 h (METR measurements, cross-checked against government AISI reports; by 2027-12-31)
status_at_phase_end: The series was introduced in March 2025 (~1 h frontier horizon, ~7-month doubling over 6 years). Frontier 50% horizon rose through 2025: ~1.5 h (Apr), ~2.3 h (Aug), ~2.7 h (Nov), then ~4.8 h (95% CI 1.8-20 h) for a Bloc A model measured in Dec 2025. End-2025 value ~4.8 h vs 16 h threshold: about 1.7 doublings short, with a recent doubling time of ~4-5 months.

items.summary: Independent evaluator introduced the task-completion time-horizon metric: the frontier 50% horizon was ~1 hour (Bloc A model, Feb 2025), doubling about every 7 months over six years, with a faster pace since 2024; extrapolation implies day-to-week-long software tasks within a decade.
items.detail: METR, 'Measuring AI Ability to Complete Long Software Tasks' (Kwa, West, Becker et al.), 2025-03-19 (verified). Claude 3.7 Sonnet ~59 min (TH1.0; later 55 min).

items.summary: A Bloc A reasoning model released in April 2025 measured at a 50% horizon of ~1.5 hours, a new frontier.
items.detail: METR measurement of OpenAI o3 (released 2025-04-16): ~1 h 30 min (TH1.0 91 min, CI 47-158 min), cited in METR GPT-5 report. Exact METR publication day for o3 not verified (April 2025).

items.summary: Pre-deployment evaluation of a Bloc A frontier model: 50% horizon ~2 h 17 min (95% CI 65 min-4 h 25 min), consistent with the faster 2024-25 trend; the evaluator judged it far from thresholds of concern (e.g. 50% horizon >40 h for AI R&D or rogue replication). It flagged early suite saturation and reward-hacking effects.
items.detail: METR, 'Details about METR's evaluation of OpenAI GPT-5', 2025-08-07 (verified via search snippet of report). 80% horizon ~25 min.

items.summary: A Bloc A coding-agent model released in November 2025 measured at ~2 h 42 min (50%).
items.detail: METR measurement of OpenAI GPT-5.1-Codex-Max (released 2025-11-19), ~2 h 42 min, cited as prior record when Claude Opus 4.5 result posted. METR publication day approximate (Nov 2025).

items.summary: Independent evaluator estimated another Bloc A frontier model at a 50% horizon of ~4 h 49 min (95% CI 1 h 49 min-20 h 25 min), above the prior trendline (doubling ~4-4.5 months); 80% horizon ~27 min. The very wide upper bound shows the suite is approaching saturation.
items.detail: METR post on Claude Opus 4.5 (Anthropic, released 2025-11-24), reposted on LessWrong and LinkedIn; date approximate (~2025-12-19/20, from X trending item ID timestamp).

items.summary: No government AI safety institute published a comparable time-horizon measurement in 2025 for cross-checking, and no Bloc B frontier model had a published horizon at the frontier level. The evaluator's 2025 suite had few tasks longer than 8 h, limiting how far above ~16 h it could measure.
items.detail: METR TH1.0 suite (HCAST 189 tasks + RE-Bench + SWAA); TH1.1 with 31 tasks of 8 h+ only released 2026-01-29.
